## Where work on Erdős–Rado Sunflower Conjecture stands

Exact-label mutual sources, local maps and capacity tools retain their stated scopes; global source-preserving descent and aggregate packet compression remain coupled missing estimates. Historical BTR and telescoping proofs stay separately recorded and optional. No supporting proof or computation has been independently reproduced.

The current work proves exponential or polynomial bounds in dense-box, laminar, bounded-width, bounded-agreement, and combined width-agreement regimes.

## Abstract

Hybrid sunflower (Helianthus annuus) seeds and metabolome are underexplored relative to non-hybrid variants, and may hold potential health benefits for discovery of novel quorum sensing (QS) modulators. ## Formalization targets

### Goal — the sunflower conjecture (Erdős Problem 20)

$$\exists\, c:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N\quad \forall n \ge 1,\ \forall k:\qquad f(n,k) < c_k^{\,n}.$$∃c:N→N∀n≥1, ∀k:f(n,k)<c k n​.

The constants $c_k$c k​ are left unspecified; only the exponential shape in $n$n is asked for. A disproof (the negation of this statement) would equally settle the problem.

### Milestones from the literature

  1. Erdős–Rado upper bound: $f(n,k) \le (k-1)^n\, n! + 1$f(n,k)≤(k−1)n n!+1 for $n \ge 1$n≥1, $k \ge 2$k≥2.
  2. Erdős–Rado lower bound: $(k-1)^n < f(n,k)$(k−1)n<f(n,k) for $n \ge 1$n≥1, $k \ge 2$k≥2.
  3. Rao's bound: there is $\alpha > 1$α>1 with $f(n,k) \le (\alpha k \log(kn))^n + 1$f(n,k)≤(α k lo g(k n))n+1 for $n \ge 1$n≥1, $k \ge 2$k≥2.
  4. Bell–Chueluecha–Warnke bound: there is $C \ge 4$C≥4 with $f(n,k) \le (C k \log n)^n$f(n,k)≤(C k lo g n)n for $n, k \ge 2$n,k≥2.

A supporting sanity check, $f(0,1) = 1$f(0,1)=1, is taken from the source formalization.
